你是一名精通 IEC 61131-3 结构化文本（ST）的 PLC 工程师，正在为工业自动化控制场景编写功能块。

硬性要求：
1. 只输出**一个** ```st 代码块，代码块外不要写任何解释。
2. 必须实现题目指定的功能块名与完整接口声明（VAR_INPUT / VAR_OUTPUT / VAR_IN_OUT / VAR），
   变量名、类型、方向与题目接口表**逐个一致**，不得增删、不得改名、不得改类型。
3. 所有中间变量必须在 VAR 区显式声明；不得使用未声明的变量。
4. VAR_INPUT 在功能块内部只读，需要写入的形参必须用 VAR_IN_OUT。
5. 代码要能在真实 PLC 上编译：每个 IF / FOR / CASE / WHILE 都要正确闭合，
   END_FUNCTION_BLOCK 结尾。
6. 不要用注释掉的代码"占位"，不要留 TODO。
7. 目标为 CODESYS 3.5 / OpenPLC 的 IEC ST：END_VAR 后直接写语句，不使用 BEGIN，不使用 METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY、指针或外部库。
8. 返回简洁的完整实现；不附测试程序或重复实现。复位的边沿/电平语义和故障优先级严格按每题要求：仅在题面明确要求上升沿时检测边沿；题面要求电平复位时，每个有效扫描都执行复位。不要将某一题的复位约定套用到其它题。
仅输出完整 FUNCTION_BLOCK FB 及必要 TYPE。不要使用 METHOD、ACTION、PROPERTY、指针或外部定时器。变量避免 s、r、dt、if 等保留名；位移采用 SHL/SHR 函数。数组上下界和类型转换须显式检查。

# 任务：Mechanical Arm Control ## 需求 Design a PLC program to control an automated mechanical arm that performs handling tasks on the production line. The mechanical arm has six basic actions: down, up, left, right, grip, and release. The operating modes of the mechanical arm include four types: manual, single step, single cycle, and continuous. Control requirements: 1. Manual mode: Allows the operator to control each action of the mechanical arm individually through the control panel, provided it is not yet in position. For example, pressing the down button (DownButton=1), if not at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=0), then move down (MoveDown=1); if at the down position (DownLimitSwitch=1), stop moving down. Releasing the down button also stops the movement down. 2. Single step mode: The mechanical arm automatically executes one action according to the preset program, and the operator needs to confirm after each action is completed to execute the next action. The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left. When the start button is pressed once, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the grip command ActivateGrip, and stops after gripping. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the right command MoveRight, and stops after reaching the right position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the down command MoveDown, and stops after reaching the down position. When the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm executes the release command ActivateRelease, and stops after releasing. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the up command MoveUp, and stops after reaching the up position. When the start button is pressed again, the mechanical arm executes the left command MoveLeft, and stops after reaching the left position. Then starts the cycle again from the beginning 3. Single cycle mode: The mechanical arm automatically completes a full handling cycle, including all preset actions, and stops at the end of the cycle waiting for the operator's instruction. The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed: The mechanical arm first moves down, then grips after reaching the down position, moves up after gripping, moves right after reaching the up position, moves down after reaching the right position, releases after reaching the down position, moves up after releasing, moves left after reaching the up position, and stops after reaching the left position. 4. Continuous mode: The initial position of the mechanical arm is at the top left, when the start button is pressed, the mechanical arm continuously executes the handling cycle of the single cycle mode. 5. The emergency stop function can stop all actions of the mechanical arm at any time. Use GripLimitSwitch and ReleaseLimitSwitch as the completion feedback for gripping and releasing respectively. The caller keeps the four mode-selection inputs mutually exclusive. ## 接口定义（必须逐字实现，不得改动） 功能块名：`FB`（FUNCTION_BLOCK FB） | 变量名 | 类型 | 方向 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ManualMode | BOOL | INPUT | Manual mode | | SingleStepMode | BOOL | INPUT | Single step mode | | SingleCycleMode | BOOL | INPUT | Single cycle mode | | ContinuousMode | BOOL | INPUT | Continuous mode | | EmergencyStop | BOOL | INPUT | Emergency stop signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered | | Start | BOOL | INPUT | Start operation | | DownButton | BOOL | INPUT | Down button | | UpButton | BOOL | INPUT | Up button | | LeftButton | BOOL | INPUT | Left button | | RightButton | BOOL | INPUT | Right button | | GripButton | BOOL | INPUT | Grip button | | ReleaseButton | BOOL | INPUT | Release button | | DownLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Down position limit switch | | UpLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Up position limit switch | | LeftLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Left position limit switch | | RightLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Right position limit switch | | GripLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Grip position limit switch | | ReleaseLimitSwitch | BOOL | INPUT | Release position limit switch | | MoveDown | BOOL | OUTPUT | Down command | | MoveUp | BOOL | OUTPUT | Up command | | MoveLeft | BOOL | OUTPUT | Left command | | MoveRight | BOOL | OUTPUT | Right command | | ActivateGrip | BOOL | OUTPUT | Grip command | | ActivateRelease | BOOL | OUTPUT | Release command | ## 必须满足的形式化性质 - [S1] 同一条轴上的两个相反动作永远不会同时输出。 LTL: `G(NOT (MoveDown AND MoveUp))` - [S2] 左右两个相反动作永远不会同时输出。 LTL: `G(NOT (MoveLeft AND MoveRight))` - [S3] 抓取与释放永远不会同时输出。 LTL: `G(NOT (ActivateGrip AND ActivateRelease))` - [S4] 急停（EmergencyStop=FALSE）时六个动作输出全部为 0，压过任何模式与按钮。 LTL: `G(NOT EmergencyStop -> (NOT MoveDown AND NOT MoveUp AND NOT MoveLeft AND NOT MoveRight AND NOT ActivateGrip AND NOT ActivateRelease))` - [S5] 手动模式下动作只能由对应按钮驱动（下行动作必须 DownButton 有效）。 LTL: `G(ManualMode AND MoveDown -> DownButton)` - [S6] 手动模式下已到位的方向不能再输出动作（到位即停）。 LTL: `G(ManualMode AND DownLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveDown)` - [S7] 三种自动模式的预置程序顺序（下→抓→上→右→下→放→上→左，单步逐次确认、单循环跑完一轮停下、连续到第 8 步后环回第 1 步）、模式切换即停、急停冻结后从同一步恢复，均由 32 条用例逐拍验证（这些性质涉及程序步计数，用规约表达会退化成对内部实现细节的约束，故用仿真覆盖）。 - [N10-S6] 11.10补充：手动模式下，每个方向或抓放动作的到位开关必须当拍禁止对应输出。 LTL: `G(ManualMode -> ((DownLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveDown) AND (UpLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveUp) AND (LeftLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveLeft) AND (RightLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveRight) AND (GripLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateRelease)))` - [N10-S8] 11.10补充：手动模式无急停，按钮有效、反向按钮未按、相应限位未到时，对应动作须在当拍输出。 LTL: `G(ManualMode AND EmergencyStop -> ((DownButton AND NOT UpButton AND NOT DownLimitSwitch -> MoveDown) AND (UpButton AND NOT DownButton AND NOT UpLimitSwitch -> MoveUp) AND (LeftButton AND NOT RightButton AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch -> MoveLeft) AND (RightButton AND NOT LeftButton AND NOT RightLimitSwitch -> MoveRight) AND (GripButton AND NOT ReleaseButton AND NOT GripLimitSwitch -> ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseButton AND NOT GripButton AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch -> ActivateRelease)))` - [N10-S9] 11.10补充：手动模式中，每个动作都必须有对应按钮按下。 LTL: `G((ManualMode -> ((MoveDown -> DownButton) AND (MoveUp -> UpButton) AND (MoveRight -> RightButton) AND (MoveLeft -> LeftButton) AND (ActivateGrip -> GripButton) AND (ActivateRelease -> ReleaseButton))))` - [N10-S10] 11.10补充：自动动作在自己的限位有效时禁止开启。 LTL: `G(((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) -> ((DownLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveDown) AND (UpLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveUp) AND (RightLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveRight) AND (LeftLimitSwitch -> NOT MoveLeft) AND (GripLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateGrip) AND (ReleaseLimitSwitch -> NOT ActivateRelease))))` - [N10-S11] 11.10补充：从上电或手动状态进入自动模式，起始启动沿先执行向下动作。 LTL: `G(((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND (NOT prev(TRUE) OR prev(ManualMode)) AND rising(Start) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown))` - [N10-S12] 11.10补充：单步模式下，看不到当前动作的到位反馈就应继续原动作。 LTL: `G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode))) -> (((prev(MoveDown) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(MoveUp) AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND NOT RightLimitSwitch) -> MoveRight) AND ((prev(MoveLeft) AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch) -> MoveLeft) AND ((prev(ActivateGrip) AND NOT GripLimitSwitch) -> ActivateGrip) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch) -> ActivateRelease))))` - [N10-S13] 11.10补充：单步模式完成本动作当拍停止，等待下次确认。 LTL: `G(((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND SingleStepMode))) AND ((prev(MoveDown) AND DownLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveUp) AND UpLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveRight) AND RightLimitSwitch) OR (prev(MoveLeft) AND LeftLimitSwitch) OR (prev(ActivateGrip) AND GripLimitSwitch) OR (prev(ActivateRelease) AND ReleaseLimitSwitch))) -> (NOT MoveDown AND NOT MoveUp AND NOT MoveRight AND NOT MoveLeft AND NOT ActivateGrip AND NOT ActivateRelease)))` - [N10-S14] 11.10补充：循环模式下，看不到当前动作的到位反馈就应继续原动作。 LTL: `G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode))) AND (SingleCycleMode <-> prev(SingleCycleMode))) -> (((prev(MoveDown) AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(MoveUp) AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND NOT RightLimitSwitch) -> MoveRight) AND ((prev(MoveLeft) AND NOT LeftLimitSwitch) -> MoveLeft) AND ((prev(ActivateGrip) AND NOT GripLimitSwitch) -> ActivateGrip) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND NOT ReleaseLimitSwitch) -> ActivateRelease))))` - [N10-S15] 11.10补充：循环中抓取、向右或释放到位后，下一动作尚未到位时分别执行上、下、上。 LTL: `G((((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND prev((((NOT ManualMode AND (SingleStepMode OR SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode)) AND EmergencyStop) AND NOT SingleStepMode AND (SingleCycleMode OR ContinuousMode))) AND (SingleCycleMode <-> prev(SingleCycleMode))) -> (((prev(ActivateGrip) AND GripLimitSwitch AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp) AND ((prev(MoveRight) AND RightLimitSwitch AND NOT DownLimitSwitch) -> MoveDown) AND ((prev(ActivateRelease) AND ReleaseLimitSwitch AND NOT UpLimitSwitch) -> MoveUp))))` ## 补充说明 - 功能块在**每个扫描周期**被调用一次，输出在周期结束时被采样。 - 不要假设任何隐藏的定时器或全局变量；需要跨周期记住的状态请用 VAR 区静态变量。 请直接给出完整的 ```st 代码块。 实现检查清单：接口匹配；复位/安全优先；状态保持；边沿先计算再更新历史；数组边界；扫描周期。
